key.name: icon-display
key.description: Show the network type icon in the panel

key.name: show-sum
key.summary: Show sum of upload and download speed
key.description: If true shows combined UP+Down speed; otherwise shows them separately

key.name: device
key.description: Empty string or 'all' = all interfaces, 'defaultGW' = default gateway interface, or a specific interface name

key.name: timer
key.description: How often the speed is recalculated

key.name: label-size
key.summary: Width of the speed label in pixels

key.name: unit-label-size
key.summary: Width of the unit label in pixels

key.name: menu-label-size
key.summary: Width of the menu labels in pixels

key.name: use-bytes
key.description: Show B/s (bytes) when true, b/s (bits) when false

key.name: bin-prefixes
key.description: Show MiB/s, GiB/s when true; MB/s, GB/s when false

key.name: vert-align
key.description: Stack upload and download speeds on two rows

key.name: show-ips
key.description: Show IP addresses for each interface in the drop-down menu
